name: 85375 · Sun City West, AZ
findings: ZIP 85375 (Sun City West) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (73%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 94 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85375 (Sun City West) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85375 (Sun City West) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 81 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
